name: java-bedrock-texture-converter
code: const fs=require('node:fs');const path=require('node:path');const os=require('node:os');const AdmZip=require('adm-zip');const sharp=require('sharp');const[,,input,output,direction]=process.argv;if(!input||!output||!['java-to-bedrock','bedrock-to-java'].includes(direction))throw new Error('Usage: node convert.js input.zip output.zip java-to-bedrock|bedrock-to-java');const javaToBedrock=direction==='java-to-bedrock',root=fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(),'pack-'));const zip=new AdmZip(input);zip.extractAllTo(root,true);const result=new AdmZip();const files=[];function walk(dir){for(const e of fs.readdirSync(dir,{withFileTypes:true})){const f=path.join(dir,e.name);e.isDirectory()?walk(f):files.push(f)}}walk(root);function target(n){if(javaToBedrock)return n.replace(/^assets/minecraft/textures//,'textures/').replace(/^assets/minecraft//,'').replace(/(^|/)block//,'$1blocks/').replace(/(^|/)item//,'$1items/');return n.replace(/^textures/(blocks|items)//,(_,x)=>'assets/minecraft/textures/'+x.slice(0,-1)+'/').replace(/^textures//,'assets/minecraft/textures/')}function add(n,b){result.addFile(n, b)}(async()=>{for(const file of files){const name=path.relative(root,file).split(path.sep).join('/');if(javaToBedrock&&name==='pack.mcmeta'||!javaToBedrock&&name==='manifest.json')continue;const out=target(name);let data=fs.readFileSync(file);if(/\.(png|jpe?g)$/i.test(name))data=await sharp(data).png().toBuffer();add(out,data)}if(javaToBedrock)add('manifest.json',Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({format_version:2,header:{name:path.basename(input,'.zip'),description:'Converted Java add('pack.mcmeta',Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({pack:{pack_format:15,description:'Converted Bedrock texture pack'}},null,2)));result.writeZip(output);fs.rmSync(root,{recursive:true,force:true});console.log('Wrote '+output)})().catch(e=>{fs.rmSync(root,{recursive:true,force:true});console.error(e);process.exit(1)})
